sources.name: x.ai Bot Marketplace
sources.installCounts: not published (every installCount reads 0), so not used

sources.name: Real install or usage counts from xAI
sources.note: xAI does not publish per-bot installs or active users for share links.

scoring.summary: How much people on X share and engage with a bot, weighted towards recent posts. A proxy for use, not an install count.
scoring.split: A post that links several Howff bots splits its weight evenly between them.
scoring.decay: Each post's weight halves every 30 days from when it was posted.
scoring.sharerBonus: +10 for every distinct X account beyond the first that shared the bot.
scoring.featured: featured = picked by xAI on the marketplace. Shown as a badge, never added to the score.
